name: Bartleby's Mug
summary: In Stormwind's Pig and Whistle Tavern, Bartleby faces a young warrior's trial. After you best him, you take his drinking mug to your trainer, Harry Burlguard.

sections.title: Trophy of a Tavern Brawl
sections.body: In Old Town, Harry Burlguard tests young warriors with a brawl. He sends you to face Bartleby, a stubborn drunk at the bar of the Pig and Whistle Tavern. Once subdued, Bartleby reluctantly gives up his prized drinking mug. First, he takes one last swig to drain the dregs.

sections.title: A Step Toward Mastery
sections.body: When you return the mug, Harry Burlguard accepts it as proof of your novice trial. He sees that you can win another's compliance through force and judges you ready to learn defense. Then he points you toward Marshal Haggard, a seasoned veteran in Elwynn Forest, for further instruction on the battlefield.

faq.q: Why does Harry Burlguard want Bartleby's mug?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard wants Bartleby's mug as proof that you fought and bested him. Bartleby clings fiercely to his drink, so surrendering his personal mug shows he was soundly beaten.
Bartleby is an unruly patron at the Pig and Whistle bar in Stormwind's Old Town. Drunken and foul-tempered, he gives local warrior trainers an informal test for up-and-coming fighters.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The brawl takes place inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town.

faq.q: What comes after returning the mug to Burlguard?
faq.answer: After Burlguard inspects the mug and confirms your victory, he teaches you advanced defensive combat stances. Then he sends you beyond the city gates to find Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Does Bartleby get hurt permanently in the brawl?
faq.answer: No. The brawl is not meant to kill Bartleby. He yields, finishes his drink, hands over his mug, and stays in the tavern with bruises and wounded pride.

faq.q: Can any Alliance class do this quest?
faq.answer: Only Alliance warriors undertake this trial as part of their level ten training in combat stances and defensive maneuvers.

angles.text: As a warrior in Stormwind, you prove you can face unruly foes by taking Bartleby's mug.
As an Alliance member, you know disorderly patrons in Old Town trouble Stormwind's martial instructors often.
